location.section: Brightline Telecom - Retention Policy

text:
[1. Purpose and scope]
This policy tells Brightline Telecom retention agents which offers they may make to customers who are at risk of leaving. It applies to residential customers only.

Risk tiers use the churn risk score from the churn model. The score ranks customers by risk. It is not a calibrated probability, and agents must not quote it to customers.

location.section: 1. Purpose and scope

text:
[2. Risk tiers and maximum discounts]
Retention discounts apply to the internet plan charge only, never to add-ons or phone lines. The absolute cap on any retention discount is 30 percent. Only one retention offer may be active on an account at a time.

location.section: 2. Risk tiers and maximum discounts

text:
[3. Eligibility exclusions]
- A customer who accepted a retention discount in the last 12 months is not eligible for another.

- Accounts more than 60 days overdue are not eligible for any discount.

- Two-year contract customers with more than 6 months remaining get a 12-month price lock, not a discount.

- The new customer promotion is for new sign-ups only and can never be used as a retention offer.

A price lock is not a discount, so the first two exclusions do not stop an agent from offering one.

location.section: 3. Eligibility exclusions

text:
[4. Contract offers, price locks and documentation]
A month-to-month customer who accepts a one-year contract receives a one-time bill credit of $50. A one-year customer who renews for two years receives a one-time bill credit of $75.

A price lock guarantees the internet plan price for 12 months. Agents may offer it at any tier and it needs no approval.

Every offer must be logged with the ticket ID, tier, discount and duration. Offers above 20 percent must also record the approver's name.

location.section: 4. Contract offers, price locks and documentation

text:
[5. How retention discounts combine with other discounts]
Contract discounts (5 percent for a one-year contract, 10 percent for a two-year contract) and the $5 automatic payment credit are standing entitlements and still apply when a retention discount is given. Percentages are added together, not multiplied, and are taken from the list price of the internet plan.

The combined percentage discount on the internet plan may never exceed 40 percent. The automatic payment credit is taken off the total monthly bill after percentage discounts. A retention discount does not stack with another retention discount or with the new customer promotion.
